set.body:
Outcome: reconcile all currently unfinished StoryModel Motes against landed work and the owner-approved release scope, so a fresh agent has a clear forward queue.
Scope: release/milestone tags, current ticket context and acceptance, supported closure/supersession, justified dependency corrections and the canonical release handoff. Preserve historical scientific specifications and all private-data admission boundaries.
Evidence: source main8d4881a9, complete S2a-3/eligibility/recovery receipts, canonical Mote CLI snapshots and before/after checks. No code algorithm, calibration claim or package release.
Acceptance: every unfinished ticket has exactly one forward release group and a readable current disposition/next action; release groups agree with22September owner decisions; no cycles, dangling dependency or silent scope bypass introduced; closure evidence is SHA-bound; fresh clone reconstructs tracked Mote state; independent exact metadata review and GitHub/BUC parity verified.
Next: capture canonical ticket detail snapshots, inspect current code/evidence for close candidates, classify and edit through Mote CLI only.
set.title: Reconcile release groups and forward ticket context
